mentions.name: RiffRadar
mentions.description: This app generates better music recommendations on Spotify, experimenting with multiple recommendation algorithms that will soon be exposed as selectable options for its playlists.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still hacking on https://riffradar.org/ and trying to make better recommendations on Spotify. Lately I've been experimenting with a couple of different recommendation algorithms, and will expose them soon as selection options for the different playlists.
mentions.author: vulkoingim

mentions.name: Riffradar
mentions.description: Riffradar is a Spotify playlist and recommendation tool that generates daily-updating playlists. Users select genres and see which bands match their selection from their library or globally, then refine playlists with advanced filters such as excluding recently played tracks, release dates, collaborations, and different sort methods. A recent feature lets users pick one or more playlists and create a "mirror" containing tracks from the artists in those playlists, with additional playlist modes in development.
mentions.source_excerpt: Been working on https://riffradar.org/ - better Spotify recommendations through playlists that update daily.
mentions.author: vulkoingim
